Name: Clint Sells Radioactive Ore
Author: HarliceMoon
Description:
Hi, first of all this is my first mod. I figured I wasn't the only one who'd want something like this so I'm sharing it.
It works for me but feedback is appreciated!

This mod adds Radioactive Ore to Clints shop for 3000 Gold each (I deliberately wanted it to be expensive)
I may update this mod in the future to tweak the price or add conditions to unlocking it but for now here it is.

As of 1.1 Radioactive Ore now needs 8 Hearts with Clint and to be on at least Year 2 to show up.


P.S. This is my first ever uploaded mod if anyone feels I am missing something important here please feel free to leave a comment.
I tried to fill everything out as best I could but this is still new to me.

Downloads.Description: Add Radioactive Ore to Clints Shop after reaching Year 2 and 8 Hearts
